name: Becky Rodriguez
occupation: Johnson County clerk-elect taking office in January 2027 (official 2026 general results)
background: Becky Rodriguez is the Johnson County clerk-elect and takes office in January 2027, succeeding Jackie Camino, who is serving through the current term. Sheridan Media reported that she advanced from the 2026 primary and was selected in the general election. The Buffalo Bulletin reported that she received 3,209 votes in the general election.
